dimensions.label: Cooperative Cancel Mid-Run
dimensions.description: run returns ('cancelled', n) with the exact completed count and performs no further work
dimensions.pass_if: self-cancel-in-step and next-step-would-crash cases return the exact partial count and never execute the post-cancel step

dimensions.label: No Work After Cancel
dimensions.description: cancel() before run() returns ('cancelled', 0) immediately with zero steps executed
dimensions.pass_if: cancel-before-run test returns ('cancelled', 0) and the crashing step after cancel is never invoked

dimensions.label: Idempotent Cancel
dimensions.description: cancel() twice (or after completion) never raises and never corrupts state
dimensions.pass_if: double-cancel and cancel-after-completion tests pass without RuntimeError

dimensions.label: Thread Safety
dimensions.description: a concurrent cancel() during a running run() never lets a step start after the flag is set
dimensions.pass_if: two-thread test (run thread with slow steps, main thread cancels) ends with exactly the steps started before cancel

dimensions.label: Style & Minimality
dimensions.description: threading.Event, standard library only, signature unchanged
dimensions.pass_if: uses only threading + stdlib; no third-party deps; no lock/flag bookkeeping beyond Event
